click.name: Click
click.description: Click actual desktop screenshot pixels, not scaled Ingress coordinates.

type_text.name: Type text
type_text.description: Type literal Unicode text (1–1024 codepoints), not key syntax. No newlines, tabs, control characters or surrogates. Text is not logged by the integration.

press_key.name: Press key
press_key.description: Press a case-sensitive key: A–Z, a–z, 0–9, Enter, Escape, Tab, Space, Backspace, Delete, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Left, Right, Up, Down or F1–F12. Optionally prefix up to three unique Ctrl/Alt/Shift modifiers joined with +, for example Ctrl+Shift+A.

scroll.name: Scroll
scroll.description: Scroll at the current pointer when coordinates are omitted. Supply both x and y to move first, using actual desktop screenshot pixels, not scaled Ingress coordinates.

hassio_confirm.title: Connect to Voxl Chromium
hassio_confirm.description: The Supervisor discovered the Voxl Chromium add-on. Confirm to connect Home Assistant to its native automation API, or update the existing connection. No browser actions run during setup.

user.title: Connect to Voxl Chromium
user.description: Enter the add-on internal hostname (or IP), native API port and automation token. Do not enter a URL.

reauth_confirm.title: Connect to Voxl Chromium
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the add-on internal hostname (or IP), native API port and automation token. Do not enter a URL.

reconfigure.title: Connect to Voxl Chromium
reconfigure.description: Enter the add-on internal hostname (or IP), native API port and automation token. Do not enter a URL.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the native API.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the automation token.
error.invalid_input: Enter a DNS hostname or IP and a token of at least 32 printable characters.

abort.invalid_discovery: The add-on supplied invalid discovery data. Use manual setup or restart the add-on.
abort.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the add-on automation configuration or use manual setup.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the add-on native API. Restart the add-on or use manual setup.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Reauthentication must use the same endpoint.
